description: createHost: Create a new host/glue record, e.g. for custom nameservers like 'ns1.example.com'. Requires authentication. Check the name first with checkHostAvailability. Returns the created host record.

hostname.description: Fully qualified host name to create, e.g. 'ns1.example.com'.

ipAddresses.description: IP addresses for the host, IPv4 dotted-quad or IPv6, e.g. ['192.0.2.1', '198.51.100.1'].

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: createHost
